title: Tactical BI: this month’s decision, departmental analysis

videos.script: On the fifth of December, Otávio closed November's books, and Renata sat down with her team to review the month. {{review}} Online sales were two million and sixty thousand reais. Is that good? The number alone cannot say. Against the budget it was eight per cent up. Against last November, twenty-four. {{compare}} And lesson 7 already told you why the second figure flatters: the yearly campaign moved into November. This lesson is the middle level of three. Managers, a month of data, and decisions that move budget, people and stock. {{screen}} You will read Renata's screen, where every number sits beside the one it is judged against. {{variance}} In your spreadsheet you compute the variance of each budget line. Then you see why a plus sign is good news on one line and bad news on the next. {{actions}} Last, the meeting itself. Three findings, an action list with owners and dates, and a next review that opens with last month's promises.
